title: US PCE on Sept 30 is next yield test

timeline.title: US PCE on Sept 30 is next yield test
timeline.line: The August PCE inflation print is due Sept 30; July core PCE ran at 3.3% YoY
more: July headline PCE was 3.7% YoY, 0.2% MoM
A hot print would reinforce Fed hike bets and pressure FII flows into India
